webAppUrl.title: MuilyOffice web app address
webAppUrl.description: Optional. Public address of the separate MuilyOffice web app, as an https origin with no path or trailing slash: https://{host}. Connecting Origin starts at {webAppUrl}/api/origin/install/start. Leave empty if you do not use the web app.
